evidence.method: Count successive independent columns. The determinant is onto F_q^× with kernel SL. For q>2 and matrix size>=2, this kernel is proper nontrivial. At q=2, GL=SL=PSL; exclude size2=S3, use the inspected PSL simplicity theorem in size>=3. Size1 uses cyclicity of F_q^×.

Direct commutator calculation gives x·y′−x′·y; nondegeneracy forces the center to be the final coordinate. Vary one coordinate to obtain every central commutator.
